faq.q: What is the origin of Aslam?
faq.a: Aslam is associated with Arabic. Aslam, elative of سالم ('safe, sound'), meaning 'safer, more peaceful'; also the verb 'to submit'. Borne by the companion Aslam.
Yes — the underlying form أسلم is Arabic.
Aslam can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
